mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% (the 25th percentile of historical values), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading exceeding 200.0 (indicating accelerating inflation) triggers market concerns about aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 200.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which negatively impacts corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (characterized by low unemployment and strong labor demand), a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals continued economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher monthly housing starts (HOUST) reflect robust consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with stronger economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 2000.0 (the 75th percentile), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) reading below 100.0 (indicating a contraction in manufacturing output) signals a supply-side slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending momentum, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (characterized by declining industrial production), a falling INDPRO reading is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during supply shocks when INDPRO is declining, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
